nodes.title: Ethiopia Guji, Light Roast, 340g
nodes.description: Our new single origin. A washed Ethiopian from the Guji zone, roasted light to keep it bright. Peach and jasmine up front, a clean tea-like finish. Whole bean, 340g, in our matte kraft bag. Roasted on Tuesdays in small batches, shipped the same week.

image.altText: Matte kraft coffee bag with a square label reading LOWLAND ROASTERS, Ethiopia Guji, Light Roast, 340g
